facts.fact: Open Access Data Centres (OADC) has deployed a carrier-neutral core data centre, OADC JNB1, in Isando, Johannesburg (1,600 sqm initial white space, 7MW); date of going live not given, article published 2023-04-03.
OADC's Rondebosch data centre in Cape Town is online (1,000+ sqm initial white space, up to 5MW); date not given, article published 2023-04-03.
Phase 2 of OADC Durban became operational around mid-December 2022, adding 110 racks at a carrier-neutral facility.

note: Lagos (NGA) content not recorded; Brackenfell described as coming up, so no fact.
